ballots.summary: All four mandated hand-checks pass: (1) tally closes exactly 118=104+9+3+2 with 118 unique check_ids, and execution-contract.json itself contains exactly 118 V_* ids with an empty contract-minus-results diff, all required=true; (2) all 24 seven-P1 fix/merge short SHAs plus baseline 6918798 exist and are master ancestors with correct implementation-to-merge direction; (3) the three artifacts are byte-identical across 0dcfec1, HEAD, and the working tree and contain zero host absolute paths and zero secret values; (4) goal_complete=false is argued from the real completion_predicate.conditional_scope contract term, backed by an 8-entry UNVERIFIED ledger matching report U1-U8, and is consistent with the V_RW_COMPLETION_REQUIRED gate semantics (any single UNVERIFIED keeps the verdict NOT complete). npm known-set signature verified verbatim (475/472/2/1, not ok 62/463, skip=1, 17435ms). Honest failure/UNVERIFIED disposition with named holders and re-verification triggers T1-T5. No blocking findings; every sampled evidence pointer resolves once the two-root layout (RV-1) is accounted for.

APPROVE the scoped VERIFY-node and run-completion decision. The artifact classifies all 118 required checks (104 PASS, 9 known environment drift, 3 UNVERIFIED, 2 FAIL), supplies detailed evidence for three real journeys, binds all seven P1 workstreams to fixes and readbacks, and honestly preserves failures, unverified capabilities, holders, and goal_complete=false. Minor metadata and provenance weaknesses should be corrected in the reporting format but do not negate the explicitly limited decision.

findings.claim: Some machine-readable execution metadata does not directly encode the final stated outcome, although the accompanying notes disclose the discrepancy.
findings.evidence: V_RW_COMPLETION_REQUIRED is status PASS with exit 1; its note says the initial run failed and a post-regeneration run passed 12/12. V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY and V_POST_DELIVERY_PERMISSIONS are PASS with null exit and seconds, while their journey records provide passing recipe counts and detailed evidence paths.

findings.claim: The relationship between the tested source baseline and the report-packaging revision should be made explicit.
findings.evidence: The artifact records baseline.source_head as 6918798, while the review scope identifies the three-artifact report at git 0dcfec1; the JSON does not provide a field binding those two revisions or hashes for the companion Markdown artifacts.

findings.claim: Approval is valid only for completion of the VERIFY run and delivery of its evidence, not for overall goal completion or full production enablement.
findings.evidence: The artifact sets goal_complete=false and lists unresolved holders for F10 cross-machine enablement, real-container S6/S7/S8, the knowledge-DB backup channel, live alert delivery, unauthenticated web-channel ACL, F01/F03 assertion mapping, runner probe naming, and GitHub readback. P1-05 also explicitly carries its real-container half as staged-UNVERIFIED.

findings.claim: Evidence pointer roots are split across two bases: per-check raw outputs cited as worker-reports/VERIFY-rework/evidence/<check_id>.txt resolve only at the repo root, while several bindings-cited rework evidence dirs (P2_5-rework, P3_3-rework, P4_3-rework) exist only under openspec/changes/delivery-foundation-rearchitecture/worker-reports/; repo-root worker-reports/ holds P1_1-rework, P1_5-rework, P2_4-rework, P3_1-rework, P4_6-rework, P4_8-rework.
findings.evidence: git ls-tree -r 0dcfec1 shows 134 tracked paths under worker-reports/VERIFY-rework at the repo root; repo-root worker-reports/VERIFY-rework/evidence/ holds 132 files including V_NPM_REGRESSION.txt and V_COMET_NATIVE.pin24.txt; ls of both worker-reports directories shows the split placement of -rework dirs.

findings.claim: Report tally 'FAILED 2' aggregates two distinct per_check status labels: FAIL_STALE_PREMISE (V_A15) and FAILED_PREEXISTING (V_FULL_CHECK).
findings.evidence: verification-results.json tally {pass:104, known_environment_drift:9, unverified:3, failed:2} vs per_check status counts {PASS:104, KNOWN_ENVIRONMENT_DRIFT:9, UNVERIFIED:3, FAIL_STALE_PREMISE:1, FAILED_PREEXISTING:1}; both non-PASS entries carry reason notes and verification-report.md sections 2/6 disclose each.
